_comment: Boot camp schedule. Safe for a non-technical owner to edit — see WISER_GENERATIONS_AI_AGENT_GUIDE.md. Dates must stay in YYYY-MM-DD form. A cohort whose end date has passed is dropped automatically, so old ones can be left in place as a record. When every cohort here has finished, the assistant goes back to saying it does not have dates and offering a strategy call — it never invents one.
_pausedComment: Owner ruling 2026-10-29: PMP work is on hold until the Living Is a Project book launches. Live classes resume in May 2027. While enabled is false, no cohort is offered anywhere and every class page shows the resume month below. To reopen: set enabled to true and add the new cohorts.
_programsComment: Tier ids from lib/constants.ts — the programs a boot camp seat enrolls into. PMP Executive and the Veterans PM Pathway are intentionally absent: those cohorts get created when they are needed. Add the tier id here when that happens.
_cohortsComment: Cohorts run Monday to Thursday, one per week, except where a holiday moved one. `skipDates` marks a day inside the range with no class — the assistant states it, and the teaching-day count is worked out from the dates rather than assumed, so it stays right. `note` is optional and is shown to visitors, so keep it short.

cohorts.note: Runs Tuesday to Friday so it does not open on Columbus Day / Indigenous Peoples' Day
